verdicts.reason: Both candidates are almost the same broken layout. The photo has shrunk to a thumbnail. The white note card is gone and has become a tiny square with stray tape scraps. Six oversized checkmarks float on a huge blue line, cut off from the list items, which are crammed at the bottom and run together ('Chin Upper lip', 'Chest Bikini Area'). '$50' is pushed to the bottom edge, the headline is jammed against the top, and the middle is dead space. B's tape piece sits slightly closer to the '$50', almost touching it, so A is marginally less bad.
